headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: LEC (9)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Emilia Romagna Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 6.1s ahead of Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Yuki Tsunoda made the biggest climb, from P20 to P10.
Lance Stroll had a day to forget, dropping from P8 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
There were 37 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 13 points over Lando Norris.
